name: DRV8825 stepper driver carrier (Pololu-style)
description: Bipolar stepper driver, 8.2-45 V, about 1.5 A per coil without extra cooling (2.2 A with good cooling), up to 1/32 microstepping.
notes: No logic supply pin: the DRV8825 makes its own logic supply from VMOT. Inputs accept 3.3 V and 5 V logic.
RST and SLP must be held HIGH (internal pull-downs). A common trick is to tie RST to SLP and both to logic HIGH.
Set the current limit with the trim pot before connecting the motor: Vref = I_limit / 2 on Pololu boards (check your clone: sense resistor value differs).
Never connect or disconnect the motor while powered: this destroys the driver.
Put a 47-100 uF electrolytic capacitor across VMOT/GND close to the board to absorb voltage spikes.
Pololu rates about 1.5 A per coil without a heatsink or airflow, up to 2.2 A with good cooling.

pins.name: EN
pins.label: EN
pins.note: Active LOW enable, pulled low on the board (enabled). Drive HIGH to free the motor.

pins.name: RST
pins.label: RST
pins.note: Active LOW reset with an internal pull-down: tie HIGH (e.g. to SLP or logic 3.3/5 V) or the driver does nothing.

pins.name: SLP
pins.label: SLP
pins.note: Active LOW sleep with an internal pull-down: tie HIGH to run.

pins.name: VMOT
pins.label: VMOT
pins.note: Motor supply 8.2-45 V. Put an electrolytic capacitor of at least 47-100 uF across VMOT and GND right at the board.

pins.name: FAULT
pins.label: FLT
pins.note: Open-drain fault output with a 1.5 kOhm series resistor. Sits where the A4988 has VDD, so a socket wired for A4988 is safe.

geometry.note: Pololu carrier footprint: 0.6 x 0.8 inch, two 8-pin rows 0.5 inch apart.
